microarch_summary: Ascend910B: AI Core compute units, two-level memory hierarchy (L0/L1), Matrix(Cube) + Vector dual compute engines
memory_hierarchy: L0 on-chip buffer + L1 multi-core shared + HBM; memory access alignment requirement: 32B
tensor_units: Cube units (16x16x16 matrix instruction level), Vector units (128 aligned vectors)
memory_bandwidth: HBM high bandwidth, affected by the 32B alignment constraint
launch_overhead: kernel launch overhead is non-negligible relative to single-op execution → prefer operator fusion when launch-bound
onchip_memory: L0 is limited; large tiles require multi-level tiling
numeric_units: fp16/bf16 native; fp32 slower → use tiling + compensation when precision-constrained
isa: AscendC DSL: C++ extension on AI Core, providing vector/cube programming primitives
constraints: Cube matrix instructions require tile sizes aligned to 16
